description:
Add property-based tests, with contract-valid generators, covering plan-hash determinism under action reordering and managed-document splice round-trip in the repository-materialization subsystem.

## Background

The plan-derivation core of the repository-materialization subsystem currently has zero property-based coverage; its strongest guarantees are narrated rather than enforced. `RepositoryDelta::new` normalization/alias rejection (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:1266`), `plan_hash` determinism (`image.rs:1385`), and managed-document splice round-trip are the textbook property targets and the headline claim.

Two properties are in scope, each driven by a `proptest` generator that produces only contract-valid inputs and an oracle that asserts an observable semantic property (not a copied constant):

**Plan-hash determinism under action reordering.** Generate distinct-path action sets: a `btree_set` of `VirtualPath` mapped to actions whose preimage matches the kind per `validate_action`, with a path-derived unique `EntryIdentity` so the physical-alias check is cleared. Because `RepositoryDelta::new` sorts its input and rejects duplicates, reordering is a boundary phenomenon: the oracle permutes the input order, builds two deltas through `RepositoryDelta::new`, and asserts `plan_hash` equality across the permutations. A discriminating half of the generator asserts `plan_hash` equality holds **iff** the two normalized deltas are equal, so the test cannot pass by collapsing distinct inputs.

**Managed-document splice round-trip.** Generate N region claims with unique, machine-distinct delimiters and content/outside bytes drawn from a delimiter-free alphabet (so `validate_regions` accepts them), interleaved into a base document per placement mode. The oracle goes through the public `render_managed_document` only and asserts the three round-trip properties: rendering is idempotent, each region's payload appears verbatim inside its region, and bytes outside all regions are unchanged.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A property-based test asserts `plan_hash` is invariant under permutation of the action set's input order, built through `RepositoryDelta::new`, with a discriminating case that ties hash equality to normalized-delta equality.
- [hard] REQ-02: A property-based test asserts the managed-document splice round-trip through the public `render_managed_document`: rendering is idempotent, each generated region's payload appears verbatim within its region, and bytes outside all regions are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: Generators produce only contract-valid inputs (action preimages matching their kind with unique `EntryIdentity`; regions satisfying `validate_regions`), and every assertion is a semantic property or relationship rather than a copied literal or field inventory.

## Notes

Use `proptest`. The suite must not add any integration-test target; place the property tests in an in-crate test module. Assert observable semantic properties per the project's semantic-test-assertions invariant, not exact hash values or copied constants.
title: Property tests for plan-hash determinism and managed-document splice
